additional_info.subject: RE: ID0418326-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R3 312719454/04] Terminal SCB CRM:02679000077
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I have carried out a fault search and here is my diagnosis:
- Black screen, terminal in default (red led).
- FC14 faulty and impossible to reset.
- Disconnection of the 24 volt power supply from the screen for testing, it is then possible to reset FC14.
- Continuity test of the display's power cables = no continuity between phase and neutral = ok.
According to my diagnosis, the screen is out of order.(
I left the screen uncluttered
to
have
access to both routers remotely).
Kind regards
